retention: Keep the active item and at most two recently passing items; durable outcomes belong in specifications, ADRs, commits, and reviews.

items.title: Build the MIT-licensed installable Linux release candidate
acceptance: Repository and release artifacts consistently declare MIT.
Two clean builds produce identical archive and SBOM checksums.
The extracted binary passes installed agy 1.1.2 diagnostics.

verification.command: python3 scripts/check.py && cargo deny check; deterministic package and extracted-binary checks
verification.outcome: passing; 33 tests, MIT metadata, reproducible artifacts, install, and agy 1.1.2 diagnostics

items.title: Publish the diagnostics-only v0.1.0-rc.1 release candidate
acceptance: Release notes state diagnostics-only scope and unsupported profile switching.
Tag and artifact versioning are consistent with v0.1.0-rc.1.
Archive, checksum, and SPDX SBOM are reproducible from the merged revision.
Hosted CI and non-Linux limitations are disclosed.
Publication occurs only after explicit user approval.

verification.command: two clean merged-revision builds, checksum, SBOM, extracted doctor, remote tag and release asset verification
verification.outcome: passing; prerelease v0.1.0-rc.1 published with three verified Linux assets after explicit approval

items.title: Establish the Linux unofficial isolated-home contract
acceptance: ADR 0007 records the product owner's approval of version-scoped reverse-engineered isolation.
Two synthetic profiles receive distinct HOME, XDG data, and runtime roots.
The child environment is cleared and reconstructed from a minimal allowlist.
Unsafe or shared isolation directories fail closed.
No real profile command or authentication mutation is enabled before dedicated-account validation.

verification.outcome: passing; 35 tests, dependency policy, compatibility, release identity, secrets, and harness checks
passing; distinct synthetic homes/XDG/runtime, cleared inherited environment, direct argv, and unsafe/shared/linked root refusal
